author: iJose5
quote: Such a bad game, I don’t see how this can be labeled GTA to begin with, the story is insufferable, the characters have no charisma specially Jason with no personality, he plays Lucia’s pet the whole time like she knows everything, dude has no personality, where are the memorable characters GTA has always given us?!?! What an absolute trash ****, yeah really nice graphics but the game requires at least a couple more years of optimization!
